message.short: I'm from the planet outherspace and I'm here on earth to help you and all lost boys. Together we reunite as 1.
message.body: I try to make people aware of what we're doing, because the way we're slowly destroying this earth is not the right path. I've found another way — the path of Happy People — where we can live happily together again, trade honestly, do what we say and say what we do — or the other way around. And from the bottom of my heart, I wish everyone a blessed life.

about.title: Henrik Seegers
about.teaser: From Almere to another path — affirmations, manifestation, and learning to smile again.
about.lead: Just my name, right? I’m Henrik Seegers, born in Westperkassel, 1965, at twelve o’clock at night exactly. As a small child I was in contact with the Most High; I said: God, if You exist, please talk to me. I got an answer, and the question was: what do you want to ask me, Henkie? I said: well, I’d rather you call me Henk, because I’m long past being a Henkie.
about.p1: I fell away from my faith because on television I see children in South Sudan starving and dying of scurvy, while here in the West we wonder whether to buy a second car or book a third holiday. If You are as good as it says in the holy scriptures, then I don’t understand a thing of this. Can You tell me whether it will ever be alright with humanity?
about.p2: And I got an answer: I find you quite a stubborn, peculiar, spontaneous little fellow, and if you think you can do better than I can, then you may take over the baton from me, and I promise you that I will support you in everything you need in life.
